description: Bornes de recharge pour véhicules hydrogène is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Grenoble-Alpes Métropole. This dataset includes all charging stations for hydrogen vehicles on the territory of the SMMAG URL: Hydrogen supply infrastructure More complete documentation of the M API, including data filtering, is available at:. Coverage: Grenoble-Alpes Métropole. The portal shows the English title as "Charging stations for hydrogen vehicles" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Grenoble-Alpes Métropole. Its keywords include hydrogene, mobilites, recharge, borne, metromobilite, station. The listing shows 3 download or service links in CSV, JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
